inventoryReplenishment.invalidBalances: {count} catalog materials have missing or invalid stock/minimum values. They are excluded from the candidate list until corrected; the list is not a complete purchasing decision.
inventoryReplenishment.unsetThresholds: {count} materials have no positive minimum threshold and are not evaluated for replenishment. Set thresholds explicitly in inventory metadata if needed.
inventoryReplenishment.supplierBeforeOrder: Save and verify a supplier on the open request before marking an external order as placed.
inventoryReplenishment.title: Replenishment planning
inventoryReplenishment.subtitle: Review low stock and track human-led supplier purchase follow-ups.
inventoryReplenishment.restricted: Only RD, Boss and Head of Production may review or edit procurement follow-ups.
inventoryReplenishment.stockCaveat: Shown stock is the saved canonical on-hand balance, not a verified physical count. Review any discrepancies under Stock consistency before purchasing.
inventoryReplenishment.workflowCaveat: These are internal requests only. Mark Ordered records an external supplier reference; Close does not mean materials were received. Received quantities must be recorded separately as audited IN stock movements.
inventoryReplenishment.loadFailed: Replenishment data could not be verified. Do not treat the list as complete.
inventoryReplenishment.minimumRule: Candidates have a positive minimum threshold and stock at or below it. Target is maximum stock when configured above minimum, otherwise the minimum itself. This is a planning reference, never a purchase quantity.
inventoryReplenishment.noCandidates: No candidates match. A blank list does not prove all inventory is physically available.
inventoryReplenishment.historyUnavailable: Audit history unavailable; do not infer no actions.
inventoryReplenishment.historyPartial: Showing at most 200 audit events; older events may exist.
inventoryReplenishment.saved: Replenishment action saved with an audit event.
inventoryReplenishment.editingWarning: Verify material, quantity and supplier yourself. No purchase is submitted automatically and no inventory balance changes here.
inventoryReplenishment.referenceRequired: Enter the supplier's real order reference.
inventoryReplenishment.reasonRequired: Provide a close or cancellation reason (at least five characters).
inventoryReplenishment.stale: Request changed or another active request exists. Refresh before deciding.
inventoryReplenishment.uncertain: Request outcome is uncertain. Refresh before retrying; reuse the same request ID for a draft creation.
inventoryReplenishment.saveFailed: This action was not confirmed. Verify your permissions and the latest request state.

inventoryConsolidation.catalogUnavailable: The material catalog could not be loaded completely. Stock totals and low-stock alerts are unavailable until a successful refresh.
inventoryConsolidation.scannerActive: Scanner active. Point at a barcode.
inventoryConsolidation.detailUnavailable: Material could not be verified or is no longer available. Return to inventory and refresh.
inventoryConsolidation.historyUnavailable: Inventory movement history could not be loaded. This does not mean there are no movements.
inventoryConsolidation.auditedStockOnly: Stock is changed only through audited inventory movements, separately from material metadata.
inventoryConsolidation.newMaterialZero: New materials start at zero stock. Record the opening quantity through the audited IN movement after saving.
inventoryConsolidation.movementUnconfirmed: The movement was not confirmed. Check the movement history and current stock before trying again.
inventoryConsolidation.metadataFailed: Material changes were not confirmed. Review the fields and retry.
inventoryConsolidation.metadataSaved: Material information saved; inventory stock was not edited.
inventoryConsolidation.barcodeLookupOnly: Scanning only finds a material. No stock is added or removed automatically.
inventoryConsolidation.barcodeNotFound: No matching material found in the loaded catalog.
inventoryConsolidation.csvWarning: CSV imports material records only, initially with stock 0. Any nonzero opening balance will be rejected; record actual stock separately with an audited movement. Format: section, group, subgroup, SKU, name, unit, stock, minimum, location.
inventoryConsolidation.csvSaveFailed: Material could not be saved (check duplicates and permissions).
inventoryConsolidation.csvImported: Created {saved} of {total} materials. Review any row failures before retrying.
inventoryConsolidation.csvPreview: Ready to create {count} materials at zero stock.

inventoryConsistency.operatorMismatch: Stock records disagree or the material is not mapped correctly. Do not retry completion repeatedly. Ask management to check Inventory → Stock consistency, physically count the material and record an audited reconciliation.
inventoryConsistency.operatorShortage: Insufficient canonical material stock. Ask inventory management to verify availability or replenish stock before completing this stage.
inventoryConsistency.title: Canonical inventory consistency
inventoryConsistency.subtitle: Compare materials (source of truth) with legacy inventory-item mirrors before production consumption.
inventoryConsistency.restricted: This diagnostic is available only to RD, Boss and Head of Production.
inventoryConsistency.warning: No balance is assumed correct merely because it exists in a database. Count stock physically before any reconciliation. No automatic historical changes.
inventoryConsistency.loadFailed: Unable to verify complete inventory parity. No values are safe to reconcile.
inventoryConsistency.unmapped: Legacy items without a canonical mapping: {count}
inventoryConsistency.unmappedAction: Some old inventory items are not linked to materials. Have a manager resolve the mapping explicitly before attempting production consumption.
inventoryConsistency.emptyPage: No discrepancies on this page. Check other pages for the complete inventory.
inventoryConsistency.inspect: Mapping or stock error — inspect database
inventoryConsistency.partial: This is a paginated diagnostic. Counts of discrepancies apply to the current page, not the entire inventory.
inventoryConsistency.countFirst: Physically count this item. Do not copy either displayed balance without verification. This adjustment updates both linked balances and creates one audit movement.
inventoryConsistency.reason: Evidence and adjustment reason (at least 10 characters)
inventoryConsistency.physicalRequired: Enter a valid non-negative whole physical count and an explanation of at least 10 characters.
inventoryConsistency.attemptLocked: An attempt is already pending with other values. Refresh and check the movement history before starting a new request.
inventoryConsistency.stale: Inventory changed or the mapping is ambiguous. Refresh, recount and start a new decision.
inventoryConsistency.failed: Could not confirm reconciliation. Retry with the same request; check inventory history before starting a new one.
inventoryConsistency.uncertain: Receipt unavailable. Review inventory history; do not submit with a new request ID.
inventoryConsistency.retry: If a network response is lost, retry with the same unchanged inputs. Never create a new operation merely because the receipt was not received.

productionEvidence.title: Original production evidence
productionEvidence.original: Read-only saved stage and order-linked inventory history. Review decisions never change stock or stage state.
productionEvidence.loadFailed: Could not verify original review evidence. Refresh before referring to any movement.
productionEvidence.orderScopeWarning: These movements are linked to the ORDER, not verified as belonging to this station. Notes mentioning a station are not proof of attribution. Compare the original work and stock ledger before deciding.
productionEvidence.truncated: This is a partial list (at most 100 records). Do not assume omitted movements do not exist.
productionEvidence.noMovements: No order-linked inventory movements were recorded in the current audit source. This does not prove that no materials were used.
productionEvidence.maxReferences: You can cite up to 10 movement records in one review action.
productionEvidence.referencesSelected: Movement IDs selected for the audit note: {count}

productionExceptions.materialReconciliationGuidance: Record whether no material was used, consumption was booked elsewhere, or inventory needs a separately authorized correction. Closing this review does not change stock.
productionExceptions.stageAgeGuidance: Check the station timeline or contact the operator before deciding. A stage-record timestamp alone does not establish that work stopped.
productionExceptions.oversightUnavailable: Production oversight source is unavailable. Stage-age and material-skip findings cannot be assessed right now; their reviews are hidden until a valid source is loaded.
productionExceptions.oversightPreviewLimited: Oversight source is capped to {limit} rows per category ({total} total signals). Some existing reviews may be outside the preview; verify against the original order.
productionExceptions.sourceOutsidePreview: Outside source preview — current condition not verified
productionExceptions.title: Production exception reviews
productionExceptions.intro: Review actual production exceptions, including overdue stage records and skipped material declarations. Assign follow-ups, retain evidence and record resolutions without changing production data.
productionExceptions.loadFailed: Production performance data could not be loaded. No complete review queue is available.
productionExceptions.reviewsUnavailable: The R25 review ledger could not be loaded. Review actions are disabled until the database migration and access are verified.
productionExceptions.bookingsUnavailable: Approved bookings are unavailable. Missed-booking exceptions cannot be assessed; the queue is partial.
productionExceptions.disclaimer: Review actions do not change a production stage, correct a timesheet, cancel a reservation or move a customer delivery date. A resolved review is a management decision, not proof that the source issue disappeared.
productionExceptions.readOnly: Only RD, Boss and Head of Production can change these reviews. You can inspect the queue.

productionExceptions.historyFailed: Review action history could not be loaded.

productionPerformance.bookingsUnavailable: Approved schedule data is unavailable. Stage performance is still shown, but booking comparisons cannot be verified.
productionPerformance.bookingsExplanation: Approved bookings come from the R22 scheduling ledger, for all dates. They are commitments, not worked hours; a completed stage may have had future bookings automatically cancelled.
productionPerformance.pastBooking: {hours} h of past approved bookings need review; booking time does not prove work was performed.
productionPerformance.title: Planned versus actual
productionPerformance.subtitle: Recent stage completions, recorded working hours, and separately reported operator progress.
productionPerformance.loadFailed: Production performance could not be loaded; check connectivity and database permissions.
productionPerformance.disclaimer: Recorded actual hours are not automatically inferred from elapsed time or a progress percentage. Comparable variance uses only completed stages with BOTH estimated and actual hours. Latest operator percentages are self-reported observations, not measured labour or verified remaining work.
productionPerformance.stationExplanation: Only stages with both hour fields are included in estimate, actual and variance columns. Missing-hour coverage is shown separately.
productionPerformance.currentExplanation: Current stages and latest operator-reported progress. Hours are stage-level recorded values; progress notes do not constitute time sheets.
productionPerformance.completedExplanation: Stage completions within the selected period, including accessible orders that have since been dispatched or archived.

scheduleReconciliation.explanation: These records require a manager to review the stage, booking or actual hours. No reservations are changed automatically.
scheduleReconciliation.daySummary: {booked} h booked + {proposed} h suggested / {capacity} h capacity

revisionIntelligence.fileError: Could not load attached order files

productionReadiness.checklistClear: No recorded checklist issues — not production approval
productionReadiness.noApproval: This report is a point-in-time advisory, not approval to start production or a reservation of materials.
productionReadiness.noIssues: No deterministic issues found in the accessible records.
productionReadiness.noMaterials: No order materials recorded. Inventory readiness is unknown.
productionReadiness.manual: Verify source drawings, material specifications, stock movements and actual station capacity before approving work.

orderGuide.title: Order guide
orderGuide.newIntro: Prepare a complete draft before submitting it.
orderGuide.savedIntro: Contextual help for this order and its next review step.
orderGuide.countHint: Field-presence signals only, not verified production readiness.
orderGuide.currentStep: In this part of the workflow
orderGuide.unsaved: These indicators reflect the current form. Unsaved changes are not yet part of the saved order.
orderGuide.saveBeforeAI: Customer data remains local until you save. Order Assistant becomes available in the saved order workspace.
orderGuide.disclaimer: These are reminders, not approvals. Attached file contents, production capacity and suitability require separate human or deterministic verification.

help.brief: Check the customer and due date, then note the sign requirements, dimensions and delivery arrangements.
help.profiles: Confirm that quantities and production profile settings match what was ordered; a template may need assigning.
help.files: Check that drawings and supporting documents are linked and readable. A file count alone does not verify its contents.
help.review: Run production readiness, resolve open questions and confirm roles and dates before any authorized status change.

sectionTip.details: Tip: record measurements, materials and decisions in saved order notes rather than assuming them.
sectionTip.files: Tip: upload source files first, then use AI Intake to extract proposed fields from a supported image or PDF.
sectionTip.intake: Tip: AI Intake suggestions are unverified until reviewed, selected and saved by a person.
sectionTip.readiness: Tip: readiness analysis is advisory; check actual inventory, equipment and schedules separately.
sectionTip.layers: Tip: a Canvas drawing does not by itself prove that manufacturing specifications are complete.
sectionTip.revisions: Tip: compare the original and updated customer files before accepting design changes.
sectionTip.changes: Tip: review decisions do not automatically update the production order.
sectionTip.chat: Tip: Assistant conversations use saved facts. Use explicit consent, and review suggestions before saving.

ask.brief: Review the saved order brief. Which customer questions, delivery requirements or technical facts are missing? Do not invent dimensions or dates.
ask.profiles: Using only saved production profiles and quantities, which specifications require verification before manufacturing? Do not guess technical measurements.
ask.files: What should I check in this order's customer drawings and PDF documents? You only know the saved file count, not the actual file contents.
ask.review: Create a practical review checklist for this saved signage order: unresolved questions, profile requirements, delivery planning and production risks. Do not change order status.

lifecycle.DRAFT: Still a draft: verify the brief and evidence before sending it for review.
lifecycle.PENDING_REVIEW: Waiting for review: the assistant cannot approve or assign a PO number.
lifecycle.CONFIRMED: Confirmed: review production handoff, responsibilities and dates.
lifecycle.IN_PRODUCTION: In production: track work, blocked stages and rework in station records.
lifecycle.READY_TO_LOAD: Ready to load: verify the loading plan and delivery details before dispatch.
lifecycle.ON_HOLD: On hold: resolve the documented blocker before production resumes.
lifecycle.DISPATCHED: Dispatched: review delivery evidence and open issues before archiving.
lifecycle.ARCHIVED: Archived: this is a historical order.
lifecycle.CANCELLED: Cancelled: no longer an active production workflow.
lifecycle.VOIDED: Voided: use the reissued order for new work.
lifecycle.default: Review the status and use dedicated workflow controls for changes.

orderAssistant.saveBeforePropose: Save the current order changes before asking AI to suggest field edits.
orderAssistant.reviewStale: These suggestions refer to an older saved version or different local fields. Save/reload and ask again before applying.
orderAssistant.profileSpecificQuestion: Review only saved production profile #{number} in this order. Check its active CNC, BENDER, FRONT, PAINTING and ASSEMBLING choices for missing requirements and contradictions. Treat disabled options as inactive, do not invent drawings or machine capabilities.
orderAssistant.nativeProfileApplyHint: Closing this window discards edits made here. Apply keeps them in the draft, not on the server.
orderAssistant.saveAndAskHint: Save the existing profile selections as a draft and open the assistant. Attachments may be added later; this does not submit for review.
orderAssistant.nativeProfileSaveHint: Edit the original CNC, Bender, Front, Painting and Assembly controls. Apply changes to the local draft, then use Save Draft to persist.
orderAssistant.title: Order assistant
orderAssistant.description: Ask about this order, find missing details or prepare fields for human review.
orderAssistant.savedOnly: Uses the last SAVED order, linked profile summaries and stage states. No file contents, live stock or unsaved form values are sent.
orderAssistant.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. The assistant answers from the last saved version; save first for current context.
orderAssistant.consent: I agree to send this order’s saved details and my questions to OpenRouter for this request.
orderAssistant.readOnly: Assistant access is limited to authorized order editors.
orderAssistant.empty: Ask what is missing, clarify production steps or request suggested fields.
orderAssistant.question: Question or task
orderAssistant.placeholder: What is missing before we can produce this order?
orderAssistant.failed: Order assistant unavailable. Your order was not changed.
orderAssistant.stale: The saved order changed. Reload it before using these suggestions.
orderAssistant.localChanged: Your form changed since these proposals were created. Ask again before applying.
orderAssistant.applyFailed: Could not verify the latest saved order. No changes were applied.
orderAssistant.unverified: These are model-reported suggestions, not verified facts. Approve individual fields only; saving is a separate action.
orderAssistant.applied: Selected fields were applied to the local draft form. Review and click Save Draft.

suggest.dimensions: Using only dimensions explicitly recorded in the saved order, explain what can be calculated reliably and which measurements remain missing. Do not assume units or cutting yield.
suggest.fabrication: Review the saved profiles and materials for fabrication questions by station, without assuming machine availability, tolerances or process suitability.
suggest.technical: Explain the deterministic technical checks for this saved order. Separate verified geometry and quantities from missing dimensions, material unit uncertainties and unresolved production questions. Do not declare it feasible or ready.

orderAssistant.canvasToolWarning: Separate Canvas tools use the existing general AI endpoint. Selection replacement may modify the Canvas, not order fields, and requires confirmation.
orderAssistant.confirmCanvasReplace: Replace the selected Canvas shapes? This changes the Canvas, not the order form.
orderAssistant.canvasPlaceholder: Ask about selected shapes or Maker.js conversion…
orderAssistant.technicalInfo: Saved order data, checked locally. No AI call is needed.
orderAssistant.technicalUnavailable: Technical checks are unavailable. No conclusion can be drawn.
orderAssistant.boundingCaveat: Rectangular bounds only, from dimensions explicitly recorded in millimetres. Not net cutting area, sheet consumption, waste, nesting, pricing or machine feasibility.
orderAssistant.technicalNoAuthority: These checks do not verify stock, manufacturing capability, file contents, approvals or a production-ready order.

technicalIssue.PROFILE_TEMPLATE: Active production template is not verified
technicalIssue.DIMENSIONS_UNVERIFIED: No explicit width and height with millimetre units; area remains unknown
technicalIssue.MATERIAL_MIXED_UNITS: The same material description uses different units; do not sum
technicalIssue.STOCK_UNVERIFIED: Stock quantities and SKU matching have not been checked here
technicalIssue.FILES_UNVERIFIED: Linked files have not been read or visually verified
technicalIssue.FILES_MISSING: No customer file is linked to the order

orderAssistant.openFileAnalysis: Analyze PDF or image with AI
orderAssistant.fileIntakeHint: Chat sees saved form choices and file names, not the contents of uploads. Select a linked PDF/image in AI Intake to analyze it and review any suggestions.
orderAssistant.nativeProfileQuestion: Review the saved CNC, BENDER, FRONT, PAINTING and ASSEMBLING profile choices. List missing requirements and contradictions. Do not invent dimensions, stock or machine capabilities.

orderIntake.analysisStale: The saved order or local form has changed since this analysis. Save or reload and analyze again; old suggestions cannot be applied.
orderIntake.profileFocusHint: Optional. Compares the chosen PDF or image against a saved profile; it does not change manufacturing selections.
orderIntake.openForProfile: Analyze a drawing for this profile
orderIntake.saveFirst: Save current order changes before analyzing or applying AI suggestions. Only saved profiles and notes are sent.
orderIntake.selectionChanged: Selected file or profile changed. Analyze this selection again before reviewing suggestions.
orderIntake.sourceChanged: Selected source changed after analysis. Analyze the new file before applying.
orderIntake.noSource: Choose an attachment or save some order notes before analysis.
orderIntake.title: AI Order Intake
orderIntake.description: Analyze order notes or an attached PDF/photo. Suggestions never change an order until you approve individual fields, and Save Draft is still required.
orderIntake.ocrCharge: Paid OCR may be billed per PDF page plus model tokens.
orderIntake.confirmPaidOcr: Submit this PDF for paid OCR? OpenRouter may charge per page and for model usage.
orderIntake.consent: I approve sending this customer material to OpenRouter for analysis.
orderIntake.analyzeError: Order analysis failed. Check provider model capability.
orderIntake.provenance: Evidence is model-reported unless explicitly marked matched. Verify against the original file before production.
orderIntake.selectOne: Select at least one suggested field.
orderIntake.changedLocally: Form changed since analysis. Analyze again to avoid overwriting recent edits.
orderIntake.changedOnServer: Order changed on server. Reload and analyze again.
orderIntake.applied: Applied locally. Review and click Save Draft. This did not save or confirm the order.
orderIntake.noProposals: No reliable fields extracted. See questions below.
orderIntake.profilesManual: Profile mappings are suggestions only. Select actual profile templates and verify quantities manually.
